hints: Leaving the pad decreases its timer. The elevator stops when the timer reaches zero unless the pad is occupied.
Power LIFT-POWER, press Enter twice, Q, then walk right twice.

tutorial_steps.title: Your power console
tutorial_steps.explanation: You are the amber technician. Reach the elevator to escape. This hub is always lit and safe. The route is dark until you power it. E opens the console without spending a turn during preparation.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press E to open the console.

tutorial_steps.title: Choose lift power
tutorial_steps.explanation: LIFT POWER uses 20 of 60 units and powers both the route lights and elevator. Selecting a circuit previews the choice; it does not apply it yet.
tutorial_steps.objective: Use Up/Down to select LIFT-POWER, then Space to switch it on.

tutorial_steps.title: Light the path
tutorial_steps.explanation: Enter applies the selected configuration. You must end every turn on a lit tile or in the hub. The elevator also needs its linked pad A to be active.

tutorial_steps.title: Start a take
tutorial_steps.explanation: Enter begins recording at the hub. Only accepted moves and waits are saved. For this movement lesson, we will save no commands; useful recordings come in the recording chamber.

tutorial_steps.title: Save the empty take
tutorial_steps.explanation: Enter again saves the take and returns you to the start. An empty take stores no movement. We use it here to enter replay and practice walking safely.

tutorial_steps.title: Launch and start playing
tutorial_steps.explanation: Q at the hub starts replay. You return to the chamber start; pads reset and selected power stays on. The blue echo has no commands in this lesson.

tutorial_steps.title: Move onto pad A
tutorial_steps.explanation: WASD or arrow keys move one tile. An accepted move advances one turn. This timed pad activates the powered elevator; while occupied, its timer resets to 3.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Right or D to step onto pad A.

tutorial_steps.title: Practice a safe retry
tutorial_steps.explanation: Pad A is active. R restores the launch snapshot: your starting position, selected power and the same recording. Pads reset too. It does not record another take.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press R to retry from launch.

tutorial_steps.title: Activate the pad again
tutorial_steps.explanation: The retry put you back in the safe hub. Move onto A again. Menus and explanations never advance turns. C clears power and recording and restarts this lesson.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Right or D to activate pad A.

tutorial_steps.title: Reach the running elevator
tutorial_steps.explanation: The lit elevator is running because its circuit is on AND pad A is active. Leaving the pad decreases its timer on each accepted turn; at zero, it stops being active unless occupied.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Right or D to enter the elevator.

lesson_summary: You powered a safe route, launched a take, activated a timed pad, retried from launch and escaped. Moves and waits spend turns; explanations do not.
